purpose: Auditable rules and assumptions used when matching pre-migration game codes to Titan product IDs.

status_definitions.verified: Supported directly by the source data or an explicit, scoped naming convention.
status_definitions.supported: Repeated evidence makes this useful for ranking, but it is not sufficient proof by itself.
status_definitions.provisional: A working hypothesis that must remain manual-only until independently verified.

rules.name: Exact normalized title identity
rules.statement: After scoped provider-prefix removal and abbreviation expansion, an exact title-token multiset is strong identity evidence.
guardrails: Require a unique strongest candidate
Do not discard numeric, RTP, edition, configuration, or branded tokens

rules.name: Provider alias normalization
rules.statement: Known historical provider codes may be normalized to their full provider identity using provider_aliases.

rules.name: Scoped studio prefix evidence
rules.statement: A studio marker inside a Titan product name can identify the underlying studio even when mapped_provider_name is a distribution route. Example: SL_RunnerRunnerArcade identifies a StakeLogic game carried through the RelaxGaming delivery route.
guardrails: Apply only to the provider-specific prefixes listed in titan_studio_product_prefixes
Never interpret arbitrary SL globally

rules.name: Route-ambiguous provider quarantine
rules.statement: Slingo, Edict, ELK Studios, and Hacksaw Gaming remain in provider-route review and are not auto-matched until the preferred Titan distribution route is audited.

rules.name: Distribution route is not studio identity
rules.statement: QTech, RelaxGaming, Oryx, OGS, GamesGlobal, iSoftBet, Spearhead and ST8 may be catalogue or distribution routes; their presence alone does not prove the original studio.

rules.name: Non-Oryx/OGS tie preference
rules.statement: When title and other identity evidence are tied, a non-Oryx/OGS route may be ranked first for review.
guardrails: Ranking only
Never resolve an automatic match solely with this preference

rules.name: Numeric and configuration suffix preservation
rules.statement: Numbers, RTP variants, table letters, editions and configuration suffixes are identity-bearing unless a family-specific rule proves equivalence.

rules.name: Pragmatic Azure ordinal family
rules.statement: Within the Pragmatic live-blackjack Azure family only, source ordinals 1 through 5 correspond to Titan suffixes a through e.

rules.name: BetCity branded variant
rules.statement: BetCity is the operator brand; when a source code contains BetCity, a Titan Branded variant is stronger than an otherwise generic title.
guardrails: Manual review until repeated examples establish the naming convention

rules.name: NBB means No Bonus Buy
rules.statement: NBB is an abbreviation of No Bonus Buy; both spellings describe the same source-side configuration.

rules.name: No Bonus Buy maps to f0
rules.statement: Historical reviewed mappings often pair NBB/No Bonus Buy with f0, but those mappings are not independent evidence that f0 universally means No Bonus Buy or distinguishes f0 from f1.

rules.name: Release chronology guard
rules.statement: A Titan release date later than the source game's first recorded activity blocks automatic acceptance and requires review.

rules.name: No-match meaning
rules.statement: Confirm no match only when no plausible game identity exists; provider-route ambiguity should be deferred, not recorded as no match.

rules.name: Ruby Play route ambiguity
rules.statement: Ruby Play frequently has identical RelaxGaming and Oryx copies. Keep it in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: Do not auto-select RelaxGaming or Oryx from title identity alone

rules.name: Bluberi Games route ambiguity
rules.statement: Bluberi titles may appear through GamesGlobal and Oryx. Keep them in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: Do not auto-select GamesGlobal or Oryx from title identity alone

rules.name: Booming Games route ambiguity
rules.statement: Booming titles may appear through GamesGlobal, iSoftBet, RelaxGaming and other catalogue routes. Keep them in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: A Booming-like product-code fragment is supporting provenance only, not a route-selection rule

rules.name: Atomic Slot Lab route ambiguity
rules.statement: Atomic Slot Lab titles may appear through Oryx and other catalogue routes. Keep them in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: An ASL marker can identify the studio but does not, by itself, choose the mapped-provider route

rules.name: Gammomat route ambiguity
rules.statement: Gammomat titles may appear through GamesGlobal and Oryx. Keep them in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: A GAM marker identifies the studio but does not, by itself, choose GamesGlobal or Oryx

rules.name: Gaming Corps route ambiguity
rules.statement: Gaming Corps titles may appear through RelaxGaming, Oryx, OGS and other catalogue routes. Keep them in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: A GC marker identifies the studio but does not, by itself, choose a mapped-provider route

rules.name: Inspired Entertainment route ambiguity
rules.statement: Inspired titles may appear through GamesGlobal, OGS, RelaxGaming and other catalogue routes. Keep them in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: An INS marker identifies the studio but does not, by itself, choose a mapped-provider route

rules.name: 1X2gaming route ambiguity
rules.statement: 1X2gaming titles may appear through RelaxGaming, OGS and other catalogue routes. Keep them in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: A 1x2 marker identifies the studio but does not, by itself, choose a mapped-provider route

rules.name: Direct mapped-provider route preference
rules.statement: When exact title/configuration candidates exist, prefer the one whose mapped_provider_name equals the normalized old provider over otherwise identical catalogue-route copies.
guardrails: Requires exact game identity as well as provider equality
Does not override an active provider-route quarantine

rules.name: Indigo Magic / O2X route ambiguity
rules.statement: Indigo Magic / O2X titles may appear through Oryx, GamesGlobal and other catalogue routes. Keep them in provider-route review until a preferred route is verified.
guardrails: An IM or OR-style product-code fragment is supporting provenance only, not a route-selection rule

rules.name: Flower Fortune Supreme legacy 94 omission
rules.statement: The legacy source RELAX_SBLT_FLOWER_FORTUNE_SUPREME_94 may map to RG_F_FlowerFortunesSupreme (Titan 687028): the core title and direct RelaxGaming route agree, while Titan omits the 94 suffix.
guardrails: Manual decision only
Does not override R007
Do not drop 94 from other titles without corroborating title and route evidence

rules.name: Manual decision precedence
rules.statement: Existing manual decisions and unified mappings are never overwritten by the rule-based dry run.
